description:
Media Player Classic - BE is a free and open source audio and video player for Windows.


AviSplitter
Fixed playback of some MPC audio files.
BinkSplitter
Added support for audio in Bink Video 2 files.
MpaDecFilter
Expanded mixer functionality for unsupported channel layouts.
The DSD stream will be converted to Float 96000 Hz.
MPCVideoDec
Improved support for Color Transfer Characteristic BT.2020.
Added H.264/HEVC 4:2:2 support for the NVDEC decoder.
Added VP9 4:2:0 12-bit support for NVDEC.
NVDEC operation has been optimized.
VideoRenderers
Fixed retrieval of the original video frame size for MPC VR and madVR.
Fixed rare EVR-CP freezes.
Subtitles
BT.2020 support added for PGS subtitles.
yt-dlp
The ability to select a preferred audio track language has been restored.
Player
Fixed the issue with the Space bar when Japanese character input is active.
Added dark theme for dialog boxes.
Fixed Windows Media Controls behavior in full-screen mode.
Additional search paths for audio tracks and subtitles have been added.
Fixed an issue with moving the player window while screen-edge snapping is enabled and the Windows taskbar is positioned at the sides or top.
Fixed the playback acceleration function when long-pressing the left mouse button.
Various interface fixes.
Installer
Updated MPC Video Renderer 0.10.9.
Updated Bulgarian translation (by jekovcar).
Updated Romanian translation (by Andrei Miloiu).
Updated Dutch translation (by beter).
Updated German translation (by Klaus1189).
Updated Turkish translation (by cmhrky).
Updated Chinese (Simplified) translation (by wushantao).
Updated Hungarian translation (by mickey).
